verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a locally run open-source image-processing CLI and library (written in C, with bindings for several languages). It is not a hosted service that collects user data, so an AI-training opt-out control is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ingests user data or ships any training-related feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
